fields.statement: Verifier at 88d5cefd read the diff and re-ran the acceptance. go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... passes: TestShipChangeBuiltin asserts rebase on.fail rebase-triage; rebase-triage on.pass conflict-fix with no on.fail; pr-green and rebased-green on.fail conflict-triage; conflict-triage on.pass conflict-fix and on.fail ci-triage; conflict-fix on.pass render-pr; rebase-merge, landed-green and rebased-merge-green on.fail conflict-triage-landed; conflict-triage-landed on.pass conflict-fix-landed with no on.fail; conflict-fix-landed on.pass rebase-merge; and max_visits 3 on both agent fixers. internal/guide passes. In internal/api, TestShipCheckConflicts (no recorded conflict fails; a recorded conflict with 0 or 2 fixes passes; 3 merge commits with the run's Review: trailer fail with '3 conflict fixes'; a resolved merge fails) passes along with every TestShip*/TestSession* test (go test -count=1 -run 'TestShip|TestSession'). The full package run reported no failed test; it failed only on wall-clock and CPU budgets on a VM at load ~11 and on the root-state guard for ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json, which the live root daemon writes, neither of which this diff touches. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-ship|ship-check)' passes (266s). That includes the new run-ship-conflict-fix.txtar: a bare origin, fake gh and fake fixer cover two conflicts before land (wait-pr and rebase) each fixed once and pushed plainly, with pr-green passing with no second triage or fixer; a post-land conflict routed through conflict-triage-landed and conflict-fix-landed back to rebase-merge with one land; a refused push ending at rebase-triage with no fixer; and a fourth conflict failing the run at conflict-triage-landed with no merge. ship code has no force push.
